zh.title: 美國航空11月終止 Hyatt 合作 達美航空接手新協議
zh.summary: 美航與 Hyatt 合作將於11月到期；現有會員享緩衝期；達美航空達成新協議
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空（American Airlines）與 Hyatt 之間的合作夥伴關係，將於 2026 年 11 月合約期滿時正式結束。
隨著與美國航空的夥伴關係即將劃下句點，Hyatt 已轉向與達美航空（Delta Air Lines）達成全新的合作協議。
針對受影響的現有會員，相關單位安排了短期的過渡寬限期（grace period），以保障會員在 11 月合約到期期間的權益。
此項合作轉變標誌著 Hyatt 的航空夥伴網絡更新，舊有協議隨合約屆滿告終後，將由與達美航空的新夥伴關係取代。

en.title: American Airlines To End Hyatt Partnership In November As Delta Signs New Deal
en.summary: American Airlines ends Hyatt partnership in November; Hyatt signs new agreement with Delta Air Lines.
body: According to a report from Simple Flying, American Airlines is set to end its partnership with Hyatt when the existing contract term officially concludes in November.
Following the conclusion of its relationship with American Airlines, Hyatt has entered into a new agreement with Delta Air Lines to establish an updated airline partnership.
Although the existing relationship between American Airlines and Hyatt will terminate upon contract expiration, current loyalty members will be granted a short grace period during the transition.
The strategic operational transition marks the end of Hyatt's partnership contract with American Airlines in November, moving forward under the new arrangement signed with Delta Air Lines.

zh.title: 聯航客機乘客涉醉酒試圖開啟機門並咬傷空服員
zh.summary: 聯合航空航班醉酒乘客涉試圖開機門咬傷空服員，已遭美FBI起訴
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 報導，聯合航空（United Airlines）班機上發生一起乘客空中滋擾事件。一名涉嫌醉酒的乘客在航班飛行途中，嘗試開啟客艙機門，並於過程中咬傷機上的空服員。
涉案人員確定為一名俄羅斯籍乘客。在事件發生後，該名乘客已接受美國聯邦調查局（FBI）的調查與詢問，針對其於機上的不當與危險行為進行釐清。
執法單位目前已對該名俄羅斯籍乘客提出正式刑事起訴。其面臨的具體控罪項目，包括干擾機組人員執行勤務以及襲擊空服人員等罪名。

en.title: United Airlines Passenger Charged After Opening Door Attempt and Assault
en.summary: United Airlines passenger faces FBI charges after trying to open cabin door mid-flight.
body: According to a report by aviation news outlet Simple Flying, an unruly passenger incident occurred aboard a United Airlines flight. An intoxicated passenger attempted to open an aircraft cabin door while the flight was in progress, and subsequently bit a flight attendant who intervened during the mid-flight disturbance.
The passenger, identified as a Russian national, was later interviewed by agents from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) regarding the in-flight behavior and assault.

Law enforcement authorities have officially filed criminal charges against the Russian passenger. The charges brought against the individual include interfering with flight crew members and performance of their duties, as well as assault.

zh.title: Simple Flying：737 MAX 10七月完測 A321XLR已載客
zh.summary: Simple Flying報導：737 MAX 10七月完測；A321XLR已載客
body: Simple Flying於2026年9月10日發布文章，標題為「Boeing's 737 MAX 10 Finished Flight Testing In July While The Airbus A321XLR Is Already Flying Paying Passengers」，指出波音737 MAX 10已於7月完成試飛，而空中巴士A321XLR已開始載客營運。
文章摘要稱，經過多年延遲，737 MAX 10接近商業服務就緒，但將顯著落後於其主要競爭對手。
根據AeroTime先前報導，2026年7月波音交付53架飛機，空中巴士交付67架；前七個月累計波音367架，空中巴士418架。
此報導凸顯兩大廠商在單走道機市場的競爭進度差距。

en.title: Simple Flying reports 737 MAX 10 finished flight testing in July while Airbus A321XLR already flying paying passengers
en.summary: Simple Flying reports 737 MAX 10 finished flight testing in July; Airbus A321XLR already flying passengers
body: Simple Flying reported on September 10, 2026 that Boeing's 737 MAX 10 completed flight testing in July, while the Airbus A321XLR is already flying paying passengers.
The article summary states that after years of delays, the MAX 10 is nearly ready for commercial service but will be well behind its main rival.
Earlier in August, AeroTime reported that Boeing delivered 53 aircraft in July 2026 versus Airbus's 67, with year-to-date totals of 367 and 418 respectively.
The report underscores the competitive gap between the two manufacturers in the single-aisle market.
